items.label: la vitamine
items.scene: A strong ant lifts an orange VITAMIN ("vee-tah-MEEN") as big as a football, looking MEAN and mighty.

items.label: la cohorte
items.scene: A COHORT ("koh-ORT") of wooden toy ducklings, all hatched the same spring, lines up along the display step.

items.label: la ponction
items.scene: The small brass plaque says PONCTION ("pohnk-SYOHN", close to English PUNCTURE): a medical puncture to draw off fluid, and also a deduction of money.

items.label: pharmaceutique
items.scene: PHARMACEUTICAL ("fahr-mah-seuh-TEEK") bottles of every colour stand in a TEAK rack.

items.label: l'antibiotique
items.scene: A capsule knight with a little shield chases cartoon germs off the display step ("ahn-tee-byoh-TEEK").

items.label: le filon
items.scene: A toy miner FEELS ON ("fee-LOHN") along a rock specimen in the display and finds a glittering gold VEIN.

items.label: l'appelant
items.scene: A PELICAN ("ah-puh-LAHN") in a little barrister's wig, the APPELLANT, APPEALS by waving a rolled scroll.
